major_cooldowns.name: Army of the Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it as your biggest cooldown as soon as it is up, and keep it synced with Dark Transformation for Commander of the Dead.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Transformation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast this off-global button alongside Army of the Dead so their cooldowns line up, and time it with add spawns if you run Outnumber.

major_cooldowns.name: Putrefy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it whenever Dark Transformation is active, and on cooldown outside that window once Forbidden Knowledge is up.

major_cooldowns.name: Death and Decay
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it only when you expect the enemies to stay standing in it, refreshing as its charges come back for sustained AoE.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id not observed in the sampled parses (talent choice); guide names it explicitly as an AoE button, base_cd_s 30 from the table.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it into a big magic damage hit or spell burst to absorb it and convert the damage into runic power.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Use it for a heavy physical hit or a dangerous mechanic, it is your strongest personal damage reduction.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Turn it on to shrug off a fear, charm, or sleep effect, and to heal yourself off Death Coil casts while it is up.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the group ahead of a big raid-wide magic damage hit for a group-wide soak.

defensives.name: Death Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it to cleanse your diseases and heal for a burst of health when you need emergency self-healing.

rules.description: Open with Outbreak, Army, Dark Transformation, Putrefy
rules.action: Open with Outbreak, then send Army of the Dead into Dark Transformation, then follow with Putrefy.

rules.description: Keep Virulent Plague up with Outbreak
rules.action: Recast Outbreak the moment the disease falls off the target.

rules.description: Scourge Strike while Lesser Ghoul stacks are up
rules.action: Press Scourge Strike while you hold Lesser Ghoul stacks, and go back to Festering Strike only once you have none.

rules.description: Epidemic over Death Coil at high target counts
rules.action: Switch your runic power spender to Epidemic once enough targets are up, and go back to Death Coil below that count.
